item.title: Trump-Modi friendship helped seal India-US trade deal: US Envoy
item.description: US Ambassador Sergio Gor says Donald Trump and Narendra Modi’s personal friendship helped finalise the India–US trade deal within a year, despite earlier tensions

item.title: How the loss of designated bedroom and bedtime rituals might be causing Indians to lose sleep
item.description: For many urban Indians, the bedroom has become a workspace, lounge and dining area, rolled into one. Rituals like changing into nightwear and making the bed have been replaced by the rhythms of a hyperconnected, always-online life. On World Sleep Day, March 13, a look at how this might be impacting us.

item.title: Four dead, several injured after bus overturns in Nizamabad, Telangana
item.description: A private bus travelling from Hyderabad to Akola overturned near NH-44 in Telangana’s Nizamabad district on Friday, killing four passengers and injuring several others.
